name: BroBench

MineLine.goal: Gather actual drops from four logs, four stone and three iron ore, with specified tools

Workbench.goal: Craft verified outputs from provided ingredients: planks, sticks, table, wooden pickaxe, stone pickaxe and furnace

Pathfinder.goal: Navigate around a wall and climb/return over a ledge without digging

CommandSense.goal: Map fixed supported command forms to exact actions; this is not LLM language understanding

SafetyLatch.goal: Enforce owner gating, reject malformed input, honor stop/locks/cancellation, reject unsupported completion, pause API failure

Trailhead.goal: One offline starter command, empty inventory, stone pickaxe and furnace carried back to the original position while alive
Trailhead.setup: Set spawnRadius to zero before connection; no terrain, items, time or agent actions are changed.

GoalSense-LLM.reason: No API key or approved paid-model test budget; never substitute command-parser scores

scoring: 100 * observed successes / scheduled cases. Retain failed and unsupported cases. Infrastructure errors and unrun cases are disclosed separately. No made-up overall score.
fairness: Use the same harness, server version, conditions, fixed cases and seeds for both versions. Final live runs execute sequentially. Record source commit and dirty flag. Blue highlights identify best measured scores, including ties; unrun entries never receive a score.
qualification: This is a small development comparison, not proof of general Minecraft reliability. The listed seeds were also used during development and are not a held-out test set. Results are not official model benchmarks. Prepared skill fixtures grant ingredients and reset terrain; Trailhead does neither. No model calls are made by the offline suite.
